advisory_research.summary: Ship the fail-closed non-recognition MVP now, preserve M3EH/M3EH-R as infrastructure proof only, do not run another broad PopSign Fresh5 fit as framed, and require Tiny2/Tiny3 gated signal proof plus Detector 0/source/region receipts before additional recognizer compute.

future_m3ei_style_entry_gates: source/licensing receipt for every active label
one-batch overfit reaches at least 0.95 train accuracy
label-shuffle negative control fails to learn
browser export/parity instrumentation exists before training
abort_gates: train top-1 remains near chance plus less than 10 percentage points after a serious checkpoint
one predicted class dominates more than 65 to 70 percent of predictions
macro-F1 remains below 0.35 after the model clearly fits training batches
loss does not move below random baseline log(K)
low false-pass is achieved only by refusing almost everything
promotion_discussion_gates: Tiny2/Tiny3 signer-independent test macro-F1 at least 0.80
model-card and active-label receipts naming exact labels

brev_spend_justification_required: M3EH or successor infrastructure proof is green
the proposed run tests a new premise rather than repeating M3DU/M3EF
allowed_fail_closed_claims: local camera self-view where implemented and consented by browser permission
manual self-check or human-review oriented practice
recognition locked until a validated browser-only model is promoted
no automated signing score in the fail-closed version
